title: Vulkan Extra
description: Modpack makes your fps better 2x than before by using Vulkan mod and mods compatible with it
body:
## Vulkan Extra

> **Where raw graphical power meets flawless optimization. Experience the next generation of performance with zero compromise.**

---

## Overview

Vulkan Extra is an elite, high-performance modpack engineered specifically for players who refuse to settle for subpar frame rates. Built upon cutting-edge rendering technologies, this pack unlocks the true capabilities of your hardware. By fundamentally rewriting how the game communicates with your graphics card, Vulkan Extra delivers unmatched responsiveness, fluid movement, and the competitive edge required for modern gameplay.

---

## Vulkan vs. Sodium

While Sodium has long been the community standard for performance optimization, Vulkan Extra pushes boundaries even further by utilizing a modern cross-platform graphics API rather than traditional OpenGL.

| Feature | Sodium | Vulkan Extra |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Rendering Engine** | Optimized OpenGL | Modern Vulkan API |
| **CPU Overhead** | Medium | Ultra-Low |
| **Stutter Mitigation** | Excellent | Flawless |
| **Max FPS** | High | Maximum |
| **Frame Consistency** | Minor drops | Rock-solid |

### The Advantage

Sodium provides incredible optimizations by streamlining traditional engine pipelines. However, Vulkan Extra completely bypasses legacy limitations. By distributing the rendering workload evenly across all CPU cores, it eliminates the single-core bottlenecks that cause stuttering, resulting in higher average FPS and significantly smoother 1% lows during intense PvP or heavy automation.

---

## Key Features

* **Maximum FPS Ceiling:** Tailored specifically for high-refresh-rate monitors. Experience frame rates that match the speed of your display.
* **Stutter-Free Exploration:** Advanced memory management ensures that chunk generation and rapid world traversal will not cause sudden frame drops.
* **Hardware Efficiency:** Reduces power consumption and thermal throttling by optimizing resource allocation across your CPU and GPU.
* **Server Ready:** Fully compatible with multiplayer environments, giving you a distinct, lag-free advantage in competitive scenarios.

---

## Technical Specs

* **Architecture:** Native Vulkan rendering pipeline wrapper.
* **Optimization Scope:** Deep engine-level multi-threading, asynchronous asset loading, and optimized particle simulation.
* **Deployment:** Pre-configured out of the box for immediate integration. No complex manual driver tuning required.

**Vulkan Extra** — Power defined. Performance perfected.
